subject.title: [Feature]: Add image viewing in the webchat file viewer.

question: Should the Control UI preview supported image files from the regular workspace browser, and should that preview reuse the existing lightbox only after the session-file download path has produced an authorized image source?
rationale: The reported behavior is real, but maintainers need to set the supported MIME-type and authorization boundary before a contributor turns the generic file editor into an image viewer.

options.title: Adopt a bounded image preview
options.body: Route supported workspace image MIME types through the existing authorized preview/lightbox flow and keep the current editor fallback for every other file type.

options.title: Keep artifact-only previews
options.body: Retain the current behavior and document that only session artifacts, not arbitrary workspace files, receive in-app previews.

options.title: Design a broader file preview surface
options.body: Define a dedicated preview architecture for images and future non-text workspace files before adding a one-off image branch.

recommendation.title: Adopt a bounded image preview
recommendation.body: Route supported workspace image MIME types through the existing authorized preview/lightbox flow and keep the current editor fallback for every other file type.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged lightbox work and follow-up investigation provide the closest established context for deciding whether the regular file-browser route can safely share that presentation path.
